ad.summary: This role is responsible for supporting data driven decision making across the business by analysing, interpreting, and reporting on data from various sources. The successful candidate will contribute to building a culture of evidence based decision making by transforming data into actionable insights that support business objectives and strategic priorities. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop analytical, reporting, and stakeholder engagement skills within a fast growing and innovative banking environment.
responsibilities: Analyse data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.

Translate data findings into clear and actionable business insights.
Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and scorecards.
Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, relevant, and aligned with business requirements.
Present findings in a clear and easy to understand manner for both technical and non technical audiences.
Collect, clean, validate, and prepare data for analysis and reporting purposes.
Assist in maintaining data quality by identifying inconsistencies, gaps, and anomalies.
Work with data owners to resolve data quality issues where required.
Engage with stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical requirements.
Translate business needs into reporting specifications and analytical outputs.
Support the development of measurement frameworks and key performance indicators.
Support business teams by identifying opportunities for operational and customer experience improvements through data analysis.

Contribute to evidence based recommendations that support business objectives.

Maintain clear documentation of reports, data sources, and business definitions.
Build positive working relationships with internal stakeholders.
Respond to reporting requests and provide analytical support to business users.
Assist in communicating analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
Develop knowledge of analytical tools, reporting platforms, and banking products.
Stay informed about emerging trends and best practices in data analytics and business intelligence.
Participate in training and continuous learning opportunities to build analytical capability.

1 to 2 years experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or similar analytical role.
Experience working with Power BI.
Experience using SQL for data extraction and analysis.

ad.title: Junior Software Engineer (AI-Enabled)

company.name: Ozow
company.about: Ozow is a leading fintech company that's redefining digital payments in South Africa and beyond. We're dedicated to making payments more accessible, secure, and convenient for both businesses and consumers. As a fast-growing player in the financial technology sector, Ozow fosters a culture of innovation, diversity, and inclusivity. We believe in pushing the boundaries of what's possible and are committed to making a positive impact on the world through our payment solutions.

ad.summary: Ozow is seeking a Junior Software Engineer (AI Enabled) to join our development team. You'll help build and maintain the solutions that power our digital payment platforms, learning from experienced engineers as we replatform and modernise our systems with AI. You'll use AI tools from day one, and we'll help you use them well: with discipline, care and an understanding of the code you ship. This is an early-career, hands-on engineering role, not an agentic AI role. Your focus is building software with AI, rather than designing autonomous, long-running agent workflows.
responsibilities: Work with cross-functional teams to build and maintain software solutions that meet high-quality standards and business requirements.
Contribute to replatforming existing systems onto modern, AI-native services, migrating well-defined pieces of functionality under the guidance of senior engineers.
Help build features that integrate with large language models (LLMs), learning techniques such as context management, embeddings and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Write clean, efficient and maintainable code following our coding standards, using AI coding tools to learn and move faster while understanding and being able to explain everything you commit.
Follow the team's standards for using AI safely across the software development lifecycle, including checking AI-generated output and protecting sensitive and payment data.
Investigate and fix bugs and technical issues, escalating early when you're stuck.
Learn how our systems are designed for scalability, security and performance, and apply those principles in the features you build.
Take part in code reviews, both receiving feedback on your code and reviewing others' to build your understanding of the codebase.
Write unit tests for your code and help test features end to end, including AI features whose outputs are not always the same.
Learn and use our CI/CD pipelines, containers and cloud environments (AWS or Azure) to get your code safely into production.
Work in an Agile environment, participating in sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
Create and maintain technical documentation for the software and processes you work on.
Learn from senior engineers through pairing, code reviews and feedback, and share what you discover about using AI tools well with the wider team.
must_have: 2 years of experience as a Software Engineer or Developer, including internships or graduate programmes
An IT Diploma or Degree, or equivalent practical experience such as a recognised coding bootcamp
Working knowledge of at least one of .NET C#, Python or JavaScript/ReactJs (more is a bonus)
Regular, thoughtful use of AI coding tools, with the ability to explain and check the code they produce
A good grasp of databases and SQL, version control (Git) and how the web works
A curious, pragmatic attitude towards AI and a strong willingness to learn
nice_to_have: Exposure to building with LLMs, for example through personal, university or work projects, beneficial
benefits: Access to cutting edge technology - Ozow Tech Stack
ad.process: During the interview process you will meet with the People team, the hiring manager, and relevant CSuite. Our process may include psychometric and technical assessments, giving you an opportunity to demonstrate your strengths, skills and potential beyond your CV and interview.
ad.apply_contact: Ready to be exceptional? Apply now! To find out more about life at Ozow, head over to our Careers Page here!
ad.other: You are an ideal candidate if you have skills and competencies including: eagerly embracing change, absorbing cross-functional skills, connecting ideas across disciplines; ability to initiate, develop, maintain and leverage outstanding relationships to influence a wide network; a trailblazer who steps up, takes charge, and creates meaningful impact; thrive in collaboration, embrace inclusion, genuine curiosity for global cultures; demonstrate strategic foresight, sound judgement, confident decisions under uncertainty; challenge norms, champion innovation, constantly seek growth; decisive doer with initiative and courageous hands-on leadership; optimism, agility, and strength to persevere under pressure; driven, proactive individuals who take ownership and push for excellence. Our Employee Value Proposition: At Ozow, we don't just process payments. We are redefining the future of how money moves. Our promise to our people is simple. Ozow is built for high impact: clear expectations, genuine investment in you, and the room to do work you are proud of. We back you to own what you deliver and how you grow, and we recognise the people who lift others, not just themselves. People are trusted to make decisions and own outcomes, where the growth you create, in yourself and in others, is part of how we succeed together. Compliance: As a fintech company, we prioritize data security, confidentiality, regulatory and compliance. Due to the sensitive nature of our work, we require individuals with a high level of integrity and trustworthiness to ensure adherence to financial regulations and industry standards. Given the sensitive nature of our work, all employees are expected to demonstrate professionalism, accountability, and a commitment to ethical conduct in line with financial regulations and industry standards.

ad.summary: We’re looking for a commercially sharp Senior Manager, Payment Partnerships to join GTXN - a Luno company and own the sourcing, negotiation and delivery of new banking and payment-provider partnerships across Africa and Southeast Asia. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging and closing arrangements with the payment providers and banks that let GTXN move money for our customers reliably, quickly and at the right cost. This is a remote-first role, and you will report to Paul Harker.
responsibilities: Identify, prioritise and build a pipeline of payment providers, banks and PSPs across African markets (and select Southeast Asian markets) that can extend GTXN’s ability to move money for Luno’s customers.
Own end-to-end deal execution: outreach, commercial negotiation, contracting and onboarding of new banking and payment-provider partners.
Manage and grow a portfolio of existing partner relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for commercial, operational and performance matters.
Negotiate commercial terms — pricing, settlement, liability, SLAs — that improve the cost, coverage and reliability of GTXN’s payment rails.
Work closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Product/Engineering to ensure new partnerships meet regulatory, licensing and integration requirements before go-live.
Monitor partner performance against agreed SLAs (uptime, settlement times, success rates) and drive remediation where partners underperform.
Track regulatory, competitive and market developments across target emerging markets that could affect partner selection or deal terms.
Represent GTXN with key partners and at industry events, building GTXN’s reputation as a partner of choice in target markets.
Feed market intelligence into GTXN’s regional expansion strategy, helping prioritise markets and partners with the strongest commercial and strategic fit.
must_have: 5-8+ years of experience in payment partnerships, business development or commercial roles at a payment service provider, bank, remittance company or fintech, with a track record of sourcing and closing deals with banks and payment providers.
Demonstrable experience engaging with payment providers and banks across African markets.
Deep understanding of cross-border payment flows and the commercial and technical mechanics of PSP and banking partnerships (settlement, FX, licensing, compliance).
Proven ability to independently source, negotiate and close commercial agreements, from first contact through contract execution and onboarding.
Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills, able to structure deals that balance cost, risk and speed to market.
Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a remote-first, distributed team, across multiple time zones and jurisdictions.
Excellent relationship-management and stakeholder-management skills, able to work cross-functionally with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product and Engineering.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Willingness to travel as required to meet partners and represent GTXN in-market.
nice_to_have: Experience doing the same in Southeast Asia is a strong advantage.
Additional languages relevant to target African (or Southeast Asian) markets are advantageous.
An existing network of relationships with payment providers and banks in target African markets is a strong advantage.
Working knowledge of, and genuine interest in, crypto and digital assets is advantageous, given GTXN's role within the broader Luno business.

ad.summary: As a Senior Manager, FP&A, you will serve as 2U’s lead Workday Adaptive Planning superuser and financial model builder, owning the backend planning infrastructure that powers our corporate forecasting. In this role, you will play a critical, hands-on role supporting high-impact initiatives across the business—building dynamic three-statement models, evaluating new initiatives, supporting business case development, driving financial modeling, and surfacing insights that inform company-wide decisions. You’ll work closely with Finance leadership and cross-functional teams to drive clarity around priorities, risks, and opportunities.
responsibilities: Help lead the annual operating plan, monthly forecasting, and long-range planning processes across the organization.
Own the consolidation of enterprise financial forecasts, budgets, and long-range plans across all business units, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency of financial assumptions.
Develop and maintain integrated three-statement financial models (income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow) to support planning, liquidity management, and executive decision-making.
Build scenario analyses, business cases, and financial models to evaluate strategic initiatives, investments, and operational decisions.
Partner with executive leadership to identify risks, opportunities, and actionable recommendations that support company objectives.
Partner with business leaders to evaluate financial performance, operational trends, and resource allocation.
Analyze monthly financial results, identify key performance drivers, and communicate actionable insights to leadership.
Develop scalable reporting, dashboards, and KPIs to monitor business performance and improve decision-making.
Support cross-functional initiatives by providing financial analysis and decision support.
Lead continuous improvements to FP&A processes, reporting, and planning capabilities through automation and standardization.
Maintain and enhance financial planning models and reporting within Adaptive Planning, ensuring data integrity, forecasting accuracy, and efficient planning processes.
Improve financial reporting infrastructure and documentation to increase transparency and scalability.
Prepare executive, Board, and management reporting materials that clearly communicate financial performance and outlook.
Lead or support enterprise strategic initiatives requiring cross-functional financial evaluation and coordination.
Support Degree partner cash collection initiatives through financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, and collaboration with business partners to improve working capital and cash flow.
Provide ad hoc financial analyses to support evolving business priorities during the company's transformation.
Foster a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Elevate analytical capabilities, financial acumen, and storytelling skills across the team.
Optimize team structure and workflows to scale with company growth.
must_have: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or related field, with 5+ years in a leadership role
Demonstrated experience managing and developing high-performing teams
Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate financial insights
Advanced proficiency with Adaptive Planning (or comparable enterprise planning systems) including model development, forecasting, reporting, and administration
Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills
Demonstrated competency in three-statement financial modeling
Proven ability to translate complex financial analyses into clear, compelling narratives for Board and executive-level presentations
